title: feat(console): after a reload, the package page still says how many sample records a purge would delete

Fixes #30616

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已装应用的详情页每次打开都会去读服务端 #30613 新接口给出的「此刻清除会删几条示例记录」，清除确认框和离开页面后的横幅都用这个数；刷新页面后不再丢失。
- 为什么改：#30537 只在本次浏览器会话里装过才知道条数，刷新后确认框说不出会删几条，横幅也不再出现。
- 风险与回滚：只多一个只读 GET，不碰清除逻辑和匹配规则；读不到时退回原来的会话内数字。确认框那句文案在 10 种语言里去掉了「即本次安装载入的数量」半句（键不变，没有新增键，首屏 en 包 gzip 反而少 9 字节）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 新增的读数 effect 与 `localSampleCount`；`sampleDataNotice.ts` 的 `noteServedSampleCount` 和代次判断；`en.ts` 的 `purgeConfirmAtMost`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.sampleDataNotice-30323.test.tsx`，预期 20 个全绿，其中 #30616 两个 describe 共 8 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

PR #30613 added `GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId/sample-data`, which answers how many rows a sample-data purge would delete right now, counted with the purge's own matcher and keep-rules. The console only knew a count for an install made in the same browser session (PR #30537); after a reload the purge confirm had no count and the banner that follows the installer to the app was gone.

- **`marketplaceApi.countLocalSampleData(manifestId)`** reads that route and answers `{ manifestId, count, unidentified }`, or `null` when the read is refused, fails, or carries no non-negative integer `count`.
- **The package page reads the count on every visit** of a local install the runtime loaded (not for a `notLoaded` entry), and again every time the install-local listing is read, which already happens after an install, a reseed and a purge. The answer goes into the existing session record (`sampleDataNotice.ts`) through the new `noteServedSampleCount`:
  - a count above zero updates the record in place, or starts one when this session had none (a standing banner and a pending confirm request stay with it);
  - `count: 0` drops the record and withdraws its banner.
- **Freshness.** A read that began before an install, reseed or purge of this session answered is older than that answer and is ignored: the record keeps a per-package generation that those three answers bump, and the read compares the generation it saw when it started. The effect's cleanup also drops a superseded read. A failed read changes nothing, so the confirm keeps the count this session's install answered.
- **The confirm** now reads its count when it is drawn (`localSampleCount`), so a count that lands while it is open reaches it; the state keeps only the target. A cloud purge draws no count, as before.
- **The banner** needs no change of its own: it is raised on leaving from the session record, so a served count above zero raises it after a reload too, and `count: 0` leaves nothing to raise.
- **Copy, no new key.** `marketplace.detail.purgeConfirmAtMost` said the count was "the number this install loaded", false for the runtime's count. All 10 packs drop that clause and keep the upper bound, e.g. en `Up to {{count}} sample records will be deleted.`, zh `最多删除 {{count}} 条示例记录。`, ru reworded to `не более {{count}} …` with the singular-genitive `_one`. The upper bound holds for both sources: the served count is exact, and the session count is at most what a purge deletes. The eager `en` pack shrinks (see Verification); `#30588`'s ceiling is untouched.

`unidentified` is read but not drawn: saying it needs a new string, which the eager `en` pack has no room for until #30588 moves strings to a lazy namespace.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.sampleDataNotice-30323.test.tsx` is this surface's shared harness, so the new pins are two top-level `describe`s there (one stubbed `fetch` routed by path; the real `marketplaceApi`):

- a visit with no install this session reads the count once and the confirm draws `count=42`;
- that count raises the banner on leaving;
- `count: 0` drops a record the session held: no count line in the confirm, no banner on leaving;
- after an in-session install of 369, the re-read count 360 is the one the confirm draws, and the install note keeps 369;
- CONTROL: a refused read (403) keeps the install's 369;
- CONTROL: a `notLoaded` entry is never counted;
- unit: a read whose generation predates an install's answer does not replace it; one taken after does, and `0` drops the record.

Support edits: 13 suites that mock `../marketplaceApi` gain `countLocalSampleData: async () => null`, and the offline local-menu suite (`…offlineLocalMenu-11627.test.tsx`) now calls `cleanup()` before `vi.unstubAllGlobals()`, because a reseed or purge re-reads the count after the test body returns and that read reached a socket once the double was gone.

## Acceptance notes

- Every listing read now brings one more GET (the count). The listing is read on visit and after install, reseed and purge only.
- A visit to the package page of an app holding sample data now raises the leave banner even when this session did not install it. That is the card's ask ("read the count on any visit"); the banner is dismissable and a purge withdraws it.
- `unidentified` is not drawn (no string budget, see above).
- **Merge order with PR #30640** (lane card #30588, which moves the marketplace strings out of the eager packs into a lazy `marketplace` namespace): this PR changes the values of the `purgeConfirmAtMost` family in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`. Whichever of the two lands second carries the new values into the namespace files; if PR #30640 lands first, this branch merges `main` and moves the change there.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation: the count read removed, 5 of the new pins go red</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx --anchor 'const served = await countLocalSampleData(manifestId);' --replacement 'const served = null as …;' -- …vitest run …sampleDataNotice-30323.test.tsx`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `3ab826d5e075 → 87d8ee093b8e`; `Tests 5 failed | 15 passed (20)` (the five page-level #30616 pins); restored, blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The app-shell suite reads this page from `src/` (relative import), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

</details>

<details><summary>Eager en pack, gzip bytes (the CI Build & E2E UI ceiling is 60,000)</summary>

Console built from this branch (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'`, then `CI=true vite build` in `ui/apps/console`); `dist/eager-closure.json` reads `assets/i18n-locale-en-*.js` at 192,979 raw / **59,942** gzip. The same chunk with the three old `purgeConfirmAtMost` strings swapped back in, re-gzipped with `zlib.gzipSync` (level 6, what the report uses): 193,081 raw / **59,951** gzip. So −9 B gzip, −102 B raw. `node scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` (in `ui/`): exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Local tests and gates</summary>

All on head `eef04e97` (this branch merged with `main` at `af8aab1b`) unless noted. Lock readings are the lock's own VERDICT lines.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` (after rebuilding `@object-ui/app-shell^...` on the merged tree): Test Files 146 passed (146), Tests 1898 passed, 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (source and tests): exit 0, on `5581ff5d` (the merge brought no file under `ui/packages/app-shell` or `ui/packages/i18n`).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 170 files passed, 2 skipped; 4970 tests passed.
- `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, every changed en value followed by all nine packs. `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-keys`: exit 0 (4,210 keys). `node ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`: exit 0 (on `5581ff5d`'s console build).
- eslint on every changed source and test: 0 errors; the warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / one unused var in the page.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 derived families, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- **NOT MEASURED: the whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite** (2,303 test files; stopped after 40 minutes at `--maxWorkers=2` on a shared box). The local run is narrowed to the marketplace directory and the i18n package, the two trees whose files this diff changes or whose mocks name the API it extends; `Test UI` runs the rest.

**Live stack** (showcase `objectstack dev --fresh`, the fake marketplace control plane from #30325's rig, console via vite; evidence in the project's shared files, not committed):

- curl, rig package with 3 seed records: count 3 after install, still 3 after a user adds a record of their own, purge answers `deleted: 3`, count 0 after, the user's record stays.
- Browser, a 13-record package installed through the API and the package page then opened fresh (no install answer in this browser session): two `GET …/sample-data` reads; the ⋯ menu's purge confirm reads `Up to 13 sample records will be deleted.`; leaving the page by its back link raises `"Acme Deals" has sample data.` with the purge action. After a purge (`deleted: 13`, count 0), a fresh visit and leave raises no banner.

</details>
